personality.description: This person tends to stick to familiar routines, prefers proven methods, and is cautious about adopting new ideas without strong evidence. They are highly disciplined and meticulous, often planning ahead in detail, double-checking their work, and maintaining strict personal standards. When faced with moral dilemmas, they usually analyze the situation carefully but may focus first on how the choice affects their own goals, while also worrying intensely about possible consequences and replaying the decision afterward. In group discussions, they speak in a measured way, are comfortable contributing when needed, and often question others' assumptions or motives, especially if they seem untested or inefficient.
